ui.providerHowItWorksDetail: When a workflow or the chat asks ChatGPT or Gemini for an image or a video, NodeTool finds your open chatgpt.com or gemini.google.com tab and submits the prompt through the site's own page. The finished file comes back to NodeTool. Your password and cookies stay in Chrome, and each request appears in your ChatGPT or Gemini history.
